The shop makes no allergen or 小麦 statement, so this stays a naturally-GF-menu finding, not a safety guarantee.

why: Three of the six published sweets are made from starches the shop names by origin — 吉野産本葛粉 (本葛きり, 本葛もち) and 熊本産本蕨粉 (本蕨もち) — served with きなこ and 黒みつ, and no item on the entire menu contains wheat; the shaved-ice syrups are 「すべて無添加の自家製」. That is REVIEW_PROTOCOL's 'some naturally-GF dishes, NO special handling' definition of options. It stays below high/dedicated because the shop publishes no allergen policy, no dedicated equipment and no 小麦 statement, so the record must keep stating the cross-contamination risk.

本葛きり (kudzu starch + 黒みつ), 本葛もち (kudzu starch + きなこ) and 本蕨もち (bracken starch + きなこ + 黒みつ) are plant-based by composition, as is the 加賀棒茶 that comes with every order and the 黒蜜きなこ shaved ice with its 無添加自家製 syrup; the dairy is confined to the 抹茶パフェ and the 白玉クリームあんみつ, which the record already flags. Weaker than the GF case — nothing is labelled vegan and shared serving utensils are undocumented — so it should not go above options.

why: The orderable menu is coffee-led and mostly naturally wheat-free — Tabelog's keyword block for the shop is コーヒー / 羊羹 / 栗羊羹 / ぜんざい / あんこ / 和三盆 / 抹茶 / 甘酒 / カフェ・オ・レ, and the free welcome item reviewers describe is 加賀棒茶と羊羹. The only wheat on the list is トースト / トーストセット, a separate toaster item. Calling the whole café 'Not gluten-free' overstates it; 'ask' keeps the reader verifying while not sending them past a coffee-and-yokan house. It must not go higher: no allergen handling is documented, it is a one-person operation, and the complimentary 季節の和菓子 arrives unbidden and unchosen, so a celiac has to decline or ask before it is set down.
